$comment: Frozen ground truth for road-to-a-page-that-says-what-it-loads Phase 1.2, written BEFORE any detector code. One entry per planted defect; the privacy-page row is split per unnamed provider. Safe twins sit under safe/ at the SAME relative paths as the planted files, so a path predicate cannot separate them. Decoys and twins appear in NO finding entry; that absence is what the false-positive figure is measured against. Row 8 carries no line: an absent sentence has no line, and the finding is located on the privacy page itself.

builds.planted: planted/ — a DE local-business build output carrying every planted defect
builds.safe: safe/ — the same site with every defect remediated
builds.decoys: decoys/ — shapes that name a keyed origin or token without loading or citing anything

decoys.why: a link is followed by the visitor, not loaded by the page
a resolver hint, not a provider request — reported undecided, never a finding
next/font/google self-hosts at build; the scan reads build output
[1] is a footnote, not a template placeholder
